_comment: P3 (017): the sweep TYPES each ask into the single #civic-query input and clicks the one 'Find it' CTA; the WORKER's router picks the workflow — there is no manual switcher. Each entry: `query` (typed, must carry a routing keyword), `markers` (rendered result incl. its own summary line so flows can't false-pass off a stale surface), optional `routedTo` (the USECASE_RESOLVED title asserted as 'Showing: <title>'). The `no-match` flow asserts the discovery card. sort-my-route is NEVER auto-routed (it carries no keywords) — reachable only via ?usecase=, so it is not a typed flow here.
